title: Coherence Geometry: The 6-5-4-1-2-3 Compression of Science
description:
This project documents a condensation result: across domains and methodologies, viable approaches collapse into a minimal, observer-invariant coherence geometry. The work removes intent-inference, narrative explanation, and redundant frameworks, leaving a closed coordinate system defined by coherence, constraints, trajectories, boundaries (phase transitions), admissibility, and scale.
The core finding is an ordering principle—6-5-4-1-2-3—that describes how scientific description stabilizes when compressed: Scale → Admissibility → Boundaries → Coherence → Constraints → Trajectories. Under this ordering, “methods” become interface layers; the underlying structure is shared. The project provides the frozen axiom set, reduction protocol, and falsifiability conditions, and shows how prior methodologies either (a) collapse cleanly into geometry, (b) become shorthand/UX, or (c) are non-admissible if they require intent or non-observable primitives.
This is not a new “field” replacing existing sciences. It is a unifying coordinate system for describing constraint-governed behavior across scales, with clear boundaries, admissibility rules, and kill conditions.
